After Kennedy's assassination, Vice President Johnson was quickly whisked away to Love Field, where he boarded Air Force One. Since Kennedy's body was also on the plane, Johnson decided to take the oath of office before departing for Washington, D.C.

The swearing-in ceremony took place in the cabin of Air Force One, with Jacqueline Kennedy, still in her blood-stained pink Chanel suit, standing beside the new President. The event was a poignant and historic moment, marking the beginning of LBJ's presidency and the end of the Kennedy era.
